name: the ☰ SAED row is never built
why: The Help row is SAED's way into the activity log; the Tampermonkey entry alone is hard to find.
grep: opens SAED's own log, named ShowAllEntityData

name: the log is named after the long @name
why: The window and every pasted report would carry the 120-character @name instead of ShowAllEntityData.
grep: opens SAED's own log, named ShowAllEntityData

name: the copy does not name the page type
why: A pasted report must say which page it came from.
grep: the copied Markdown names the page type

name: the row never hears about the counts
why: The counts on the row are how a user notices that something went wrong without opening the log.
grep: warnings and errors show as counts on the row

name: the error count is not painted
why: An attribute nobody draws is no count at all; the test reads the computed ::after content.
grep: warnings and errors show as counts on the row

name: the window goes into document.body
why: Under Event Horizon document.body is its body, which V removes: a window opened there is lost.
grep: lives in MusicBrainz's body and comes back after V

name: the ☰ SAED row is never built (phone)
why: On a phone the row is the only way in: Tampermonkey's menu is out of reach in most mobile browsers.
grep: a tap on the row opens the log full screen
